name: Anjoy Foods Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Anjoy Foods Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, processing, production, wholesaling, retailing, and sale of quick-frozen food products in China. It sells frozen food, including quick-frozen prepared food, quick-frozen rice and flour products, and quick-frozen prepared dishes. The company offers quick-frozen flavored and processed food such as stuffed meatballs, fish tofu, fish roe buns, and pork sausage under the Anjoy brand. Its quick-frozen prepared products include dishes such as crayfish, shrimp paste, fried crispy strips, beef and lamb rolls, Qianye tofu, and egg dumplings.
